22609.d: Sanguine bear is a monster found in Moonsylvar Wood.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
They inhabit the Moonsylvar Wood.

Step-by-step guide to reaching the sanguine bear:

# Start at the Ancient Willow: Head to the large central tree (the Ancient Willow) that serves as the portal hub.
# Follow the portals east: The golden rule for the bears is to head as far east as possible.
# The "back and forth" trick: If you enter a room and the portal to the east isn't available, don't move in another direction. Take the portal you just came from to return to the previous room, then enter it again. This "resets" the paths until you can continue moving to the right.
# The cub indicator: On the correct path, you will first arrive at a room filled with sanguine bear cubs. This is the sign that you are on the right track.
# The Bear Cave: The portal immediately after the cub room will take you directly to the Sanguine Bear Cave (exactly 4 rooms east of the Ancient Willow), where the mother bear awaits.

22615.d: Sanguine creepers are stronger variants of sanguine crawlers found in the Sanguine Glade within the Moonsylvar Wood, requiring level 28 Slayer to damage.
22615.ex: A small tree that has been corrupted by the Sanguine.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
# Start at the Ancient Willow: go to the large central tree (the Ancient Willow), located in the centre of the portals.
# Follow the portals west: your final destination is exactly 4 rooms west of the Willow.
# Use the sanguine crawlers as a guide: you'll know you're on the right path if you start encountering sanguine crawlers in the rooms.
#* Each room in the correct direction will have an increasing number of monsters: the first will have 1, the next will have 2, and the room right before the clearing will have exactly 3 crawlers.
# The "back and forth" (reset) trick: If you enter a room and the portal to the west isn't available (or if you enter an empty room with no crawlers), do not proceed. Take the portal you just came from to return to the previous room, then enter it again to reset the maze.
# Reaching the clearing: upon crossing the final western portal from the room with 3 crawlers, you will enter the Sanguine Glade. You'll know you've reached the right spot when you see a large sanguine evil bloodwood tree.

22616.d: The sanguine evil bloodwood tree is scenery located within the sanguine glade in Moonsylvar Wood, accessed by following paths with incrementing numbers of sanguine crawlers and backtracking when none are present.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Stonevein amulet to tree mural, then head east.
• Canoe station to Amberfell, climb over the barricade to south-east, then head east.
